Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Tulsa hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 12 of the 18 Tulsa hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 2, the hotel's own site at 2, Traveluro at 2, Booking.com at 1, Evendo at 1, Expedia.ca at 1, Priceline at 1, trivago DEALS at 1 and 1 other site at 1 between them. These are the Tulsa rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 10 of the 18 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. At the other 8, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 2 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line. Taxes and fees at Tulsa hotels

At the 14 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 14% ($12 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 5% at Osage Casino Hotel - Tulsa to 17% at Aloft by Marriott Tulsa. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
